data.offering_description: Operates an online marketplace that connects travelers with hosts offering homes, rooms and experiences. It earns booking fees from guests and hosts, delivered through websites and mobile apps.

data.primary_services: short-term home rentals; hotel booking; experiences and tours; business travel management

data.customer_segment: B2C: travelers booking stays and experiences, and individuals hosting homes; B2B: companies booking business travel through Airbnb for Work

data.end_markets: travel and tourism; hospitality; real estate

data.revenue_model: service fees: guest and host fees charged on each booking

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: marketplace connecting hosts with guests, sold to travelers and hosts; service provider: host support, cleaning and experiences booked through the platform

data.geography_served: global: worldwide, with listings in many countries and regions

data.specialization: related lines: short-term home rentals, experiences, and business travel

data.distribution_channels: online: company website and mobile apps for guests and hosts; partners / resellers: travel partners and integrations with other booking sites

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: local short-term rental rules, occupancy taxes, and data privacy laws

data.offering_description: Operates an online marketplace connecting hosts who list homes and other stays with guests seeking short- and long-term accommodations. It also offers bookable local experiences and services. It earns fees from hosts and guests on each booking through its website and apps.

data.primary_services: online lodging marketplace; booking of local experiences; host and guest payment processing; services such as guest support and host tools

data.customer_segment: B2C: Travelers booking stays and experiences, individual hosts listing properties; B2B: Professional property managers and boutique hotels listing inventory

data.end_markets: travel and tourism; short-term lodging; hospitality; local experiences

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: service fees charged to guests and hosts as a share of each booking; transaction or usage fees: fees on experiences and services booked through the platform

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: two-sided marketplace matching hosts' listings with guests, via website and apps; financial intermediary: processes payments between guests and hosts, holding funds until check-in

data.geography_served: global: Listings in over 220 countries and regions worldwide

data.specialization: related lines: stays marketplace, experiences and services, all on one booking platform

data.distribution_channels: online: Airbnb website and mobile apps; partners / resellers: channel managers and property-management software integrations feeding listings

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: Short-term rental laws, local zoning and registration rules, tax collection, consumer protection and data privacy rules

data.offering_description: Operates an online marketplace that connects homeowners with local home repair, maintenance and improvement professionals. Sells memberships and per-lead or per-job fees to those professionals and offers homeowners online booking and reviews.

data.primary_services: online matching of homeowners with local pros; service booking; pro ratings and reviews

data.customer_segment: B2C: homeowners seeking repair, maintenance and improvement work; B2B: local home service contractors and professionals listed on the platform

data.end_markets: home services; home repair; home improvement; home maintenance

data.revenue_model: subscription: monthly memberships paid by service professionals for platform access; transaction or usage fees: per-lead and per-job fees paid by service professionals

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: online marketplace matching homeowners with service professionals, sold to professionals and consumers; service provider: booking and coordination of home service jobs for homeowners, with fees taken from pros

data.geography_served: US national: Nationwide across the United States, current international scope uncertain

data.specialization: niche specialist: single online home services marketplace line

data.distribution_channels: online: website and mobile apps where homeowners find and book pros; direct sales: sales teams signing up local service professionals as paying members

data.regulatory_exposure: low: only normal business rules, consumer protection, advertising and data privacy laws apply

data.offering_description: Operates an online marketplace connecting homeowners with local home service professionals for repairs, remodeling and maintenance. Earns fees from service professionals for leads and jobs, and offers homeowners tools to search, compare reviews and book services.

data.primary_services: online home services marketplace; lead generation for service professionals; service booking and quote requests; advertising for service professionals

data.customer_segment: B2C: homeowners seeking repair, remodeling and maintenance services; B2B: home service professionals and contractors who pay for leads and advertising

data.end_markets: home services; home improvement; remodeling; home maintenance and repair

data.revenue_model: transaction or usage fees: fees from service professionals per lead or per booked job; advertising: service professionals pay for advertising and premium placement; subscription: membership and subscription fees from some service professionals

data.value_chain_position: software / platform: digital marketplace taking in service professional listings and homeowner requests, connecting both sides

data.geography_served: North America: United States primarily, plus Canada

data.specialization: related lines: lead generation, booked-services marketplace and advertising for home services

data.distribution_channels: online: website and mobile apps for homeowners and professionals; direct sales: sales team enrolling service professionals in advertising and lead programs

data.regulatory_exposure: low: general consumer protection, advertising and data privacy rules, professional licensing handled by providers
